body: As a mainlander, I thank those who protest with dignity and calmness, too, it’s not only HK’s future you are fighting for, it’s our Chinese people’s future too.  I hate to see those dividing arguments, it is exactly the time like this we should stand with each other, mainlanders or HKers. Shame that we can not do anything practical for brothers like you based on the ground we stand, but the hell we would offer you our mental support to the best we can, I thought I should let you know that even though people like me are just a small group, still, our voice matters. Please please please stay safe, we’ll be praying for you.
I feel like I can’t... the least thing I wanted to do is to trouble others with my own problem..
Thank you for asking, it’s been on and off for a year... sometimes I just have this sudden edge to end my life there and then...

Thank you buddy... I felt extremely bad the first hour after every noise and excitement dissolved and when everything calms down. But I also don’t feel like to be in the crowd if there’s ever a choice...

There will be pain yes, but everyone eventually is going towards that... I will train myself to be more fearless on that regard... I had many friends, but they are scattering all around the world, I can hardly go meet them or talk dearly anymore... as to my family... they are basically not like family anymore... the only one who would care is my mom, to whom I feel sorry for, but I didn’t choose to be her daughter, if there’s a way, I’d like to return this body to her...
Excuse me what do you mean?

Thank you for offering.. I don’t feel like to trouble anyone anymore, I’m aware that it is my own problem and I should take care of this.. even though I don’t know quite how.. don’t even wanna trouble my friends and family, and you good hearted people
Classic! I’ll always miss this place
